topic: A neighbor wants to install a fence
text: The fence seems like a quiet, unassuming barrier at first glance, but it speaks of endings and beginnings. It's as if the neighbor is trying to define the space where the world has already been so fluid. The trees that once whispered secrets between our yards might now murmur against this new boundary. I wonder if the fence will keep out more than just the physical; perhaps it will hold back the ease with which we once shared the sky, the sound of laughter floating freely. The ground where it'll stand used to be a place where boundaries didn’t matter, where my steps and theirs blended into a common path. Now, the thought of hammer and nails seems to weigh heavier than the quiet moments they’ll replace.
